National average retail prices of the CPI basket commodities

Source: R/retail-prices.R
knbs_retail_prices.Rd

Returns the monthly national average retail prices the KNBS CPI Explorer publishes for the 22 commodities it tracks — maize flour, bread, milk, petrol, house rent and the rest — one row per commodity per month, in Kenya Shillings per the stated unit and quantity.

Usage

knbs_retail_prices(
  commodity = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  end = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  cache = knbs_option("cache"),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

commodity

Keep only these commodities, by CPI001-style code (exact) or by name (matched as text).

start, end

Keep only these months. A year, a "YYYY-MM" month, or a date.

source

Source id.

cache

Whether to use the local cache.

refresh

Whether to bypass any cached response.

Value

A knbs_prices tibble with columns commodity_code, commodity, unit, quantity, period, period_label, price and source_id.

Details

These are national averages only: the source holds no regional retail prices. The portal states no licence; knbs_metadata() on the result says so. A range query retrieves the full history once (a few seconds, then cached); an exact single month is fetched directly.

See also

knbs_get_indicator() for the price indices the same portal serves.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
knbs_retail_prices(commodity = "petrol", start = 2024)
knbs_retail_prices(start = "2026-06", end = "2026-06")
} # }
